/* Modal styles */
.slides-modal {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
  z-index: 9999;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.slides-modal.active {
  display: flex;
}

.slides-modal-content {
  /* largest 16:9 box that fits the viewport, so the deck fills it */
  width: min(96vw, calc(96vh * 16 / 9));
  height: min(96vh, calc(96vw * 9 / 16));
  max-width: none;
  position: relative;
  background: #000;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.slides-modal iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}

.slides-modal iframe.ready {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* cover shown while the embedded deck initializes, so its brief
   loading/thumbnail state never flashes through */
.slides-loading {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.slides-loading.hidden {
  display: none;
}

.slides-loading .spinner {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  border-top-color: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: slides-spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes slides-spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.slides-modal-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  right: 10px;
  color: white;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 10000;
}

.slides-modal-close:hover {
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
}

<!-- Modal for offers -->
<div class="slides-modal" id="slidesModal">
<div class="slides-modal-content">
<button class="slides-modal-close" onclick="closeSlides()">×</button>
<div class="slides-loading" id="slidesLoading"><div class="spinner"></div></div>
<iframe id="slidesFrame" src=""></iframe>
</div>

<script>
let _slidesRevealTimer = null;

function openSlides(url) {
  const frame = document.getElementById('slidesFrame');
  const loading = document.getElementById('slidesLoading');
  // Keep the deck hidden behind the spinner until it has loaded and settled,
  // so the deck's brief loading/thumbnail state never flashes.
  frame.classList.remove('ready');
  loading.classList.remove('hidden');
  clearTimeout(_slidesRevealTimer);
  const reveal = function() {
    clearTimeout(_slidesRevealTimer);
    frame.classList.add('ready');
    loading.classList.add('hidden');
  };
  frame.onload = function() {
    clearTimeout(_slidesRevealTimer);
    _slidesRevealTimer = setTimeout(reveal, 350);
  };
  _slidesRevealTimer = setTimeout(reveal, 1600); // fallback if onload is slow
  frame.src = url;
  document.getElementById('slidesModal').classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function closeSlides() {
  const frame = document.getElementById('slidesFrame');
  clearTimeout(_slidesRevealTimer);
  document.getElementById('slidesModal').classList.remove('active');
  frame.classList.remove('ready');
  frame.src = '';
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

// Close on escape key
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeSlides();
});

// Close on click outside
document.getElementById('slidesModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeSlides();
});
</script>
